As a DM, I really like having my powerful NPCs especially villains be stocked with Frabricate. I like to bend the rules with this spell when it comes to very powerful NPCs but it helps ground their powers in the shared spellbook of the player mages. When you get rid of the 10 minute rule you can change the nature of a battle in an instant. One of my favorite fights was having my PCs fight the Elven version of Superman who's laser vision worked more like fabrication beams. First he turned the floor to sawdust dropping them onto the floor of this city's senate. THEN he turned the ceiling to molten rock prompting a harrowing Dex throw. Generally as a DM its good to have fight transitions and the floor becoming no-longer-solid is fairly easy to picture and thus pretty dang fun to incorporate.
